country.evidence_quote: The Student Union of the University of Vaasa (VYY) is an advocacy and service organization of over 5000 students. We work actively to advance students’ wellbeing, sense of community, and ability to influence society. We are a visible, effective actor on campus at the University of Vaasa and in the student life in Vaasa and Finland.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Wappuradio Wappina is a wappuradio founded in 2014 and executed annually. Engineering students from Vaasa run radio Wapina. The radio operates approximately for 10 days during wappu celebrations and broadcasts alternative entertainment in the form of an online radio. Students on campus, from freshers to senior academics, can give radio hosting a try.
